River has shifting sandbars ideal for camping, no motorboat traffic

Pack light for kayak camping; canoe can carry bulky items

Group discounts automatically applied based on number of boats, trip date, and length

blurb: Guests rent canoes or kayaks to paddle and camp on the Lower Wisconsin River, which features shifting sandbars ideal for camping. The river is protected and offers a wilderness experience with no electricity or bathrooms on sandbar campsites. The company provides equipment, shuttle service, and safety support for trips.
extraNote: Full payment required at reservation time · Cancel within 24 hours for no penalty; full refund minus $10 admin fee until 7 days before trip · Within 7 days, cancellations get gift certificate valid 1 year · No refunds or credits within 24 hours of departure or after check-in · Full refunds for day trips if severe weather watch/warning between 8am-3pm on trip day · Overnight trips not eligible for weather refunds · Trips cancelled automatically if river depth >4 feet; full refund issued · Short season, typically summer months
